description: LD-203 reports (Senate LDA, filing year 2008 on): what lobbyists and their firms give, each item naming the HONOREE (covered official). One row per filing. 'No contributions' certifications (about half) are excluded unless include_empty=true. Name filters: case-insensitive substring. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_lobbyist_contributions

contribution_type.description: Exact LDA code: 'feca' FECA campaign contribution, 'he' Honorary Expenses, 'me' Meeting Expenses, 'ple' Presidential Library Expenses, 'pic' Presidential Inaugural Committee.

filer_type.description: 'lobbyist': an individual lobbyist's report; 'registrant': a firm's report (stored as 'organization').
